name: Slot Machine

features.name: Sticky coin respins
features.description: Three coins start three respins that reset.

features.name: Coin-count multiplier
features.description: More coins mean a bigger multiplier.

review:
A nostalgic 3x3 with a lever, a blue cabinet and classic casino symbols. Three or more coins stick and start a respin bonus.

You get three respins that reset with every new coin, and the more coins you collect, the bigger the multiplier you win. Very high volatility, 2,124x max and 97% RTP, with the bonus roughly once every 95 spins. It's Panda Luck without the panda.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 95 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
